description: This is a Java test class for the MessageService component in the OpenMRS notification module. It contains unit tests to verify message creation and sending functionalities.

classes.name: MessageServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for testing MessageService in OpenMRS notification module.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
